title: rhobound.data-contract/v1
description: The data contract's registry as one document, docs/mcp/data-contract.json: every registered code with its level, trigger, condition, fix, behaviour at 1a2df09 (codes a capture triggers), the section that defines it, the registry version that added it, its status and the names of the numbers its findings carry. Generated from the registry in internal/contract by tools/gencontract, with the code tables of DATA.md 3.14 and 19. The server's rhobound://data-contract resource is this document, canonical; `rhobound explain --section data_contract` carries a subset of each row (code, level, trigger, fix, status), cut to its max_chars.

today.description: the behaviour at 1a2df09; codes a capture triggers only

numbers.description: the names of the numbers a finding or a refusal of the code may carry; a stored finding with another is not one the registry makes
